nom: La Roche-Posay - Toleriane Dermallergo - Crème Hydratante Visage - Apaise et Renforce la Barrière des Peaux Sensibles Allergiques - Neurosensine, Sphingobioma, Eau Thermale - Soin Visage Hydratant

avis.texte: Excellente crème, elle n'a causé aucune réaction allergique à une personne pourtant très sensible et qui désespérait de trouver un produit qui ne donne pas d'irritations.
Je n'ai pas encore utilise ce produit mais il a coute presque 30 E alors que le flacon est MINUSCULE!

Me encanta!!! Sabía que siendo la Roche Posay iba a acertar seguro. La piel además de calmada y protegida queda muy suave, no es densa por lo que no te hace sentir incómoda. La volveré a comprar seguro porque tengo problemas de piel y la verdad es que me está funcionando.

avis.titre: 保湿力は乳液とクリームの間くらい
avis.texte: テレビで女医さんが保湿にオススメしていたので、乾燥肌の改善に購入してみました。値段の割に量が少なく驚きましたが、少量でものびが良いので、ワンプッシュで顔全体を塗ることが出来ます。 塗った感覚は乳液とクリームの中間くらいの保湿だと思います。 乾燥が酷い所だけは重ね塗りをしています。 もう少し割安なら嬉しいかな、と思います。

avis.titre: Great for when my skin needs extra hydration
avis.texte: I’ve had a very good experience with this cream. I have seborrheic dermatitis, acne-prone oily/combination skin, so I need products that are gentle but still effective, and this has worked really well for me. This cream is thicker and more nourishing than the fluid, so I use them differently depending on what my skin needs. I alternate between them based on my skin condition and any other treatments I’m using. For example, after using acids, I usually reach for this cream because it gives my skin more comfort and hydration. It’s fragrance-free, very gentle, and feels soothing on irritated or stressed skin. Even though it is richer than the fluid, it still doesn’t feel overly heavy, and it hasn’t clogged my pores or caused problems for me. It helps reduce that tight, uncomfortable feeling and makes my skin feel calmer. I also really like the packaging. The pump is hygienic and easy to use, and you can twist it closed, so there’s no need for an extra plastic cap. I use the cream, the fluid, and the night cream from the same range, and they all work very well together. If you have sensitive, reactive, or acne-prone skin and want something a bit richer for days when your skin needs more support, this is definitely worth trying.

I suffer with rosacea and had an episode of perioral dermatitis, this moisturiser is perfect if you have either of these ! Tried so many brands including the simple range which only irritated my skin. It’s non greasy, has no scent and leaves your skin feeling soft and relieved. I’m on my second bottle and it has calmed my rosacea and after consistent use has got rid of my dermatitis. Price seems a little for a moisturiser, but a little goes a long way and it’s totally worth the money !
